product.title: Jackson Hole Whitewater Rafting Classic from Jackson Hole,Wyoming

description.text: Hold on for a wild ride down 8 miles (13 km) of the Snake River during this river rafting excursion. Paddle through Class III rapids as you paddle alongside your expert river guide. The journey takes you down whitewater sections followed by calm waters. Ideal for travelers basing in Jackson Hole who want a guided Wyoming outing without self-driving mountain roads.
